matrix.cells: explicit ordered list of applicable tuples
matrix.uniqueness: each tuple appears exactly once; stable cell id is derived from the ordered tuple
matrix.applicability: include a tuple only when its artifact variant is declared applicable for that exact Python/platform pair; do not infer missing tuples by Cartesian expansion
matrix.evidence_rule: each required gate has exactly one evidence object per listed cell; optional gates are BLOCKED or omitted only under the gate's omission rule
matrix.artifact_reuse: an immutable artifact hash may occur in multiple cells, but each cell requires independent run-scoped evidence

id_rules.assertion_order: assertions array order per gate is normative
id_rules.matrix_cell_id: manifest-derived digest of canonical tuple [python, platform, artifact_variant]
id_rules.evidence_id: unique per observation; never reused across gates, cells, or reruns

evidence_rules.blocked_requires: non-empty blocker and no promotion to PASS
evidence_rules.observed_assertions: exactly the expected assertion IDs, once each, in catalog order
evidence_rules.redaction_map: canonical entries plus policy/version metadata and SHA-256 hash; redaction never silently changes the assertion input
evidence_rules.deterministic_reuse: only immutable content-addressed outputs with matching complete provenance may be reused, and reuse_of must identify the original run and output
